stem:
Lata compares a sundial, a candle clock, and an hourglass.

Which claim correctly matches a device to the observable change it uses to mark time?

options.text: A sundial uses the changing position of a shadow cast in sunlight.
A sundial uses a shadow that keeps marking time at night with no sunlight.
A candle clock uses only the smell of the wax.
An hourglass uses a candle flame getting shorter.

teacher.key_rationale: A sundial marks time by the changing position of a shadow in sunlight. Night use without sunlight, wax smell, and a candle flame are the wrong observables for those devices.
